title: Menyumi: Sages Whose Father Was Named Menyumi

paragraphs: Rʹ Gidel bar Menyumi—[Berakhot 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.49a.22). Rav Huna bar Menyumi—[Avodah Zarah 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.39a.14).

notes.text: This collective list does not establish that all ten sages shared a father. The checked texts explicitly name Rav Huna, Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Chananyah. Gidel’s shortened title remains neutral here.

The consulted Berakhot gives Giddel’s name without a title. Eruvin preserves a chain of Rav Kahana bar Tachlifa through Rav Kahana bar Menyumi and Rav Kahana bar Malkiyo, with an alternate version identifying the final two transmitters. This is one of several independent notices in the list.
